text:
ana (PM): quick sync — we need to decide on the "capacity stitching" plan for dedicated pools. customer asks coming in re: cross-region reserved pooling + burst quotas. propose we lock scope this sprint: minimal cross-region failover + quota propagation, push advanced spillover to next phase. thoughts?
mike (Eng): sounds reasonable. minimal should include: 1) mapping tenant->primary pool 2) read-only replica pools for failover 3) propagated burst credits TTL
sam (Eng-Infra): agree. implementation note: cross-region KV syncing w/ eventual consistency OK for first pass. will need a migration path for existing tenants.
talia (SRE): important to define SLOs if we allow cross-region failover. what are latency SLAs during failover? we should cap allowed extra latency and alerting windows.
josh (Eng-Platform): +1 to SLO gating. also need to decide autoscale policy when stitched pools see sudden surge. Do we allow immediate scale-up in target region or funnel to primary?
ana (PM): @josh propose autoscale policy: on failover, operate in "grace mode" for 60s where we prioritize correctness and low-cost fallbacks, then allow autoscale up to X% of primary capacity. If tenants need immediate capacity beyond that, they opt into "aggressive failover" addon.
mike (Eng): technically doable. we'll need to add a config flag on tenant resource: "failover_behavior: graceful | aggressive". default graceful.
sam (Eng-Infra): migration complexity: for existing dedicated tenants, we'll populate default flag = graceful. bulk migration script needed.
nora (Customer Success): customer-facing constraints: customers asking for seamless cross-region burst. They will accept small latency bump but not failed requests. need clear launch messaging and a docs snippet.
talia (SRE): monitoring hooks: create a per-tenant failover metric + alert when failover_rate > 0.5% sustained 5m. also track token-level errors and p95 latency.
josh (Eng-Platform): rollout plan idea: 1) internal alpha with a few internal tenants 2) invite pilot customers (3) GA with opt-in console toggle + API flag. rollout gating: no data loss, failover observed <1% error.
mike (Eng): tech checklist: - KV sync proto + tests - tenant config flag - failover routing policy - autoscale hysteresis tuning - migration script - e2e chaos test
ana (PM): can we map these to sprint owners? mike -> KV sync + migration, sam -> infra infra pieces + chaos tests, josh -> routing + console, talia -> SLOs/alerts + runbook, nora -> docs + customer comms.
mike (Eng): will start a WIP PR. estimate 3 sprints for minimal scope.
sam (Eng-Infra): 3 sprints ok if we scope conservative — no aggressive spillover, no cross-region write caching.
talia (SRE): need an oncall rota for pilot: assign SRE buddy for first 48h of pilot windows.
nora (Customer Success): will line up two pilot customers that requested cross-region. will prep comms once we have runbook.
josh (Eng-Platform): for autoscale numbers, propose default: allow 25% of primary capacity in target region during grace window, after 60s allow up to 100% if system stable. we can tune.
mike (Eng): jotting down config: "failover_window_seconds":60, "grace_capacity_pct":25.
ana (PM): launch criteria checklist draft: - KV sync verified under load - failover runbook + SLOs - pilot with <0.5% errors - console toggle + API flag documented - migration plan + dry-run tested
talia (SRE): add: observability dashboards live + alerting threshold smoke-tested.
josh (Eng-Platform): add: autoscale hysteresis params added to config and verified in chaos tests.
sam (Eng-Infra): question: billing/credits during stitched bursts — do we deduct from original reserved quota or from target region's quota?
nora (Customer Success): customers expect deductions from their committed reserved pool. prefer we maintain single ledger per tenant.
mike (Eng): implement single ledger approach: owner pool decrements, target region consumes "loaned" credits tracked in ledger metadata. need small billing change.
ana (PM): scope negotiation: billing ledger + UI change might push us 1 sprint. options: A) ship minimal without UI footprint (backend-only ledger + API) B) delay for UI. preference A for faster pilot.
josh (Eng-Platform): agree on A. we'll expose ledger via API; console will show later.
mike (Eng): noted. will break out UI as follow-up ticket.
sam (Eng-Infra): risk: ledger inconsistency on network partition. we'll add an eventual reconciliation job that runs every 5m.
talia (SRE): add compensating alerts for reconciliation failures.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: patch/kv-sync -> staging at 2026-04-02T03:00Z
ana (PM): next steps: - mike open RFC + rough design doc by EOD Friday - sam add chaos test plan - josh spec API flag shape - talia draft SLO + runbook - nora draft customer pilot invite email
mike (Eng): will create RFC: 1791112222-capacity-stitching-rfc.md and link here when ready.
ana (PM): thanks everyone. we'll reconvene Wed sync for final sprint commitments. :thumbsup:
